full_judgment: 26. When we are faced with such injustice done to a citizen by the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes in his reassessment and imposition of penalty, we could not find any reason to deny the prayer for exercise of our jurisdiction under Article 102(2)(a)-(ii) of the Constitution to advance justice. We also could not condone the refusal of the Commissioner of Taxes in deciding the matter on merit for technical reason of limitation, even if Annexure G, copy of an application addressed to the Commissioner of Taxes for condonation of the delay in making the application for revision under section 121 of the Ordinance is not taken into consideration. The Commissioner of Taxes has got ample power to correct any incorrect assessment by the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes under the Ordinance.
